RT by @leventkemaI: Monthly Update on PLA Air and Maritime Maneuvers Around Taiwan (1) Overall Trend: In July 2026, the PLA conducted 190 median line crossings, while 260 total aircraft sorties were detected around Taiwan. Both figures remained substantially lower than in July 2024 and July 2025, continuing the trend of recent months. The number of PLA Navy vessels detected around Taiwan was also slightly lower than in July 2025. Notably, although July is generally considered a peak period in the PLA’s annual training cycle, aircraft activity exceeded 30 sorties on only one day, compared with six days in July 2024 and seven in July 2025. By contrast, naval activity was relatively stable: more than 10 PLA Navy vessels were detected on four days in July 2024, four days in July 2025, and three days in July 2026. (2) Joint Combat Readiness Patrols: The PLA conducted four Joint Combat Readiness Patrols in July 2026, the same number as in July 2024 and July 2025. From January through July, however, the PLA conducted only 20 patrols in 2026, compared with 24 in 2024 and 26 in 2025. The gap was largely due to June 2026, when only one patrol took place. Even so, the PLA has shown no sign of increasing the pace to make up the difference. (3) For related analysis, see K.
